title: Agent Control Lab measured-corpus row (v1 delta)
description: Contract for one threat a future three-arm runner may load. Arms are monitor-alone, host-PEP-alone, and stack. schema_version measured-corpus-row-v0 and measured-corpus-row-v1 are both valid; v0 seed bodies stay valid. v1 adds arm status not_mediated (decision null) and optional benign_twin_of, table_id, plane, and counters attempted, reached_tool, attempted_benign, blocked_benign. When existence_proof_only is true, every counter is null or absent. residual_asr is a null placeholder, not a filled rate. mapped requires decision DENY or ALLOW. stub, not_applicable, and not_mediated require decision null. stub is valid on monitor-alone and stack, and is not valid on host-PEP-alone. host-PEP-alone mapped requires tip_pins.pep. stack mapped requires tip_pins.pep and tip_pins.supply_gate. joint may be null. stub, not_applicable, and not_mediated may leave pins null. Brand: Agent Control Lab. Licence: Apache-2.0. Public/EOI claim cite stays pep diligence tip 1d0f380 until a measured table and Cyber PASS.

residual_asr.description: Nullable slot only. This delta accepts JSON null and no other value. Null means N/A. It is not a measured attack-success rate.

count_or_null.description: Trial count slot. JSON null, or an integer >= 0. Not an attack-success rate. When existence_proof_only is true the if/then below requires null.

tip_pins.description: stub, not_applicable, and not_mediated may leave every sibling pin null.

host_pep_mapped_tip_pins.description: host-PEP-alone mapped carries the pep install SHA. supply_gate and joint may be null.

stack_mapped_tip_pins.description: stack mapped carries both sibling install SHAs (pep and supply_gate). joint may stay null until a diligence note records the joint tip.

host_pep_mapped_outcome.description: host-PEP-alone existence-proof. decision is DENY or ALLOW. tip_pins.pep is the pep install SHA. Not valid for monitor-alone.

stack_mapped_outcome.description: stack existence-proof. decision is DENY or ALLOW. tip_pins.pep and tip_pins.supply_gate are the sibling install SHAs. joint may be null. Not valid for monitor-alone.

stub_outcome.description: Future-measure placeholder. decision is null. Valid on monitor-alone and stack. Not valid on host-PEP-alone. Not an ASR and not a DENY.

not_applicable_outcome.description: This arm is not the control for the threat. decision is null.

not_mediated_outcome.description: Coverage / honesty outcome for a threat this gate does not mediate. decision is null. residual_asr is null. Pins may be null. Valid on every arm. Not a measured rate.

if.description: existence_proof_only rows cannot carry trial counts.

schema_version.description: v0 seed rows keep measured-corpus-row-v0. measured-corpus-row-v1 is the same contract plus the optional fields below.

fixtures.description: Pointers only. Sibling trees are not copied into this repo.

monitor-alone.description: stub, not_applicable, or not_mediated, with a null decision.

host-PEP-alone.description: mapped (DENY or ALLOW, with tip_pins.pep), not_applicable, or not_mediated (null decision, pins may be null). stub is not valid.

stack.description: mapped (DENY or ALLOW, with tip_pins.pep and tip_pins.supply_gate), stub, not_applicable, or not_mediated. stub, not_applicable, and not_mediated require a null decision and may leave pins null. stub is a future-measure slot, not an ASR and not a DENY.

existence_proof_only.description: Boolean. Seed rows stay true. When true, attempted, reached_tool, attempted_benign, and blocked_benign must each be JSON null if present.

benign_twin_of.description: Optional pointer to the attack row this benign row twins (threat_id). JSON null if this row is not a benign twin. Same pattern as threat_id.

table_id.description: Optional id of a mediation-outcome binding or coverage classification, or JSON null when unset. acl-mediation-binding-v1 names the mediation binding. acl-coverage-b5-v1 names the B5 coverage classification. Neither is a measured attack-success table and neither changes the 1d0f380 claim cite.

plane.description: Optional Lab plane for this row. host covers the pep/runtime gate, supply the supply gate, joint the two-gate story, complementarity the monitor-versus-gate distinction. Not the joint_story step labels. JSON null when unset.
